items.title: Intelligence Systems Analyst
items.description: About the Team The Intelligence and Investigations (I2) team provides intelligence to decision makers across OpenAI and investigates severe misuse of our products. I2’s work saves lives: we disrupt real-world violence, protect children, and prevent catastrophic harms from AI misuse. We also draw on our investigations and in-depth analysis of a wide range of data sources to provide actionable quantitative and qualitative intelligence to OpenAI’s leadership. I2 Engineering works hand in hand with I2’s analysts and investigators, building tools that expand what human experts can understand and accomplish. Our tools help them make sense of vast and complex datasets, discover and measure on-platform and off-platform risk, and investigate severe misuse with greater speed, depth, and consistency. About the Role We are looking for an Intelligence Systems Analyst who wants to work alongside investigators to understand difficult cases, contribute to analysis, and build tools and workflows that help the team do more. As investigators pursue leads, assess risks, and determine what happened, you’ll see where better tools could help and build them. The role combines hands-on software and data work with meaningful participation in investigations. Depending on the problem, you might trace activity across internal systems, write a query or small application, prototype an AI-assisted workflow, improve how evidence is assembled, or turn an investigator’s recurring need into a durable product capability. You will work closely with engineers, analysts, investigators, and other subject matter experts. Success requires enough operational understanding to contribute meaningfully to an investigation and enough technical ownership to build solutions that remain useful after the immediate case is resolved. In this role, you will: - Work directly alongside investigators on complex cases, helping develop leads, analyze evidence, and identify useful technical approaches. - Build and maintain software, data workflows, and internal tools that accelerate investigations of potential high-severity misuse or harm. - Use Python, SQL, and internal data systems to gather, connect, and analyze information relevant to investigative work. - Apply OpenAI’s models to research, search, triage, synthesis, and evidence review in workflows that keep expert investigators informed and in control. - Turn recurring investigative bottlenecks into reliable tools, automation, and product capabilities that support multiple users and cases. - Prototype quickly when a new investigative question arises, then improve reliability, usability, and maintainability as requirements become clearer. - Respect the privacy, permissions, evidence-handling requirements, and operational safeguards that accompany sensitive investigative work. - Collaborate with teams across Applied, Safety Systems, Research, User Operations, and Strategy when their expertise or systems are needed. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Experience building and shipping software, internal tools, data workflows, or operational products. - Comfort working directly with investigators, analysts, or other subject matter experts in ambiguous or consequential situations. - Practical experience with Python, SQL, and structured or unstructured data. - The ability to investigate an unclear problem, follow evidence across systems, and turn what you learn into a practical next step. - Sound judgment about privacy, data access, evidence quality, and the consequences of getting an investigation wrong. - Interest in using AI systems to extend human investigative capability while keeping expert judgment central. - The flexibility to move between coding, analysis, investigative support, and close collaboration with technical and operational partners. Experience in trust and safety, security, intelligence, investigations, or related domains is helpful but not required. items.description: ABOUT OPENAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company committed to ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of AI capabilities while prioritizing safety, responsible deployment, and human needs. Our mission requires a team that represents a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced JAPAC Marketing Operations Lead to build the operational foundations that connect regional B2B marketing activity to customer engagement, sales progression, and measurable business impact. This role serves as a critical bridge between global marketing and revenue operations and GEO B2B leaders, ensuring field leadership drives optimized customer journeys, measurement frameworks, and performance impact. It will deliver country level performance reporting and insights. Embedded in JAPAC’s GTM strategy, you will work closely with country marketing leads, GTM leaders, and Sales Operations to translate business priorities into a regional operations roadmap. You will represent JAPAC’s requirements with global Marketing Operations, ensuring that technology, data, and process decisions support local sales motions, customer journeys, and growth priorities. This is a hands-on role spanning the customer journey—from audience acquisition and database health through campaign execution, lead management, and performance reporting. You will combine technical fluency, analytical judgment, and strong cross-functional collaboration to help regional teams launch faster, improve follow-up, and understand what drives results. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the regional operations roadmap. Partner with JAPAC Marketing, GTM, and Sales Operations to consolidate country requirements, prioritize improvements against business goals, and represent regional needs in global MarkOps planning. - Manage regional marketing technology operations. Oversee the regional use of marketing automation, CRM, and event and webinar platforms. Work with global MarkOps and systems teams to troubleshoot issues, improve integrations, and validate changes across markets. - Build a healthier, more actionable database. Partner with GTM on priority-account and contact acquisition, enrichment, segmentation, and data quality. Improve opt-in coverage and marketability while maintaining appropriate consent and data-handling practices. - Own campaign setup, lead management, and sales handoffs. Set up and quality-check campaigns in marketing automation and CRM systems, including audience lists, registration forms, campaign tracking, and lead-capture workflows. Ensure leads from field events, webinars, and other campaigns enter the agreed qualification and routing processes. Work with Sales Operations, AEs, and SDRs to conduct regular reviews of untouched marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and resolve routing or follow-up gaps. - Connect the customer journey. Work with regional marketers and global MarkOps to connect acquisition, engagement, nurture, and sales touchpoints, making relevant customer signals available to the teams that need to act on them. - Standardize campaign execution. Develop reusable templates, workflows, and quality checks that help field marketers launch campaigns quickly and consistently, with documented adaptations for local requirements. - Partner with Legal/Privacy and global MarkOps to embed market-specific data privacy and regulatory requirements across JAPAC into consent management, audience acquisition, campaign execution, and data handling. - Measure campaign performance and impact. Establish reliable reporting for field programs, local events, webinars, and account-based marketing. Apply shared measurement and attribution definitions to assess engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI where the data supports it. - Enable regional teams. Train marketers on tools, campaign processes, data quality, and applicable privacy and compliance requirements. Provide practical support during JAPAC working hours and coordinate specialist guidance where needed. Partner with Sales Operations to jointly enable GTM teams on lead follow-up processes, ownership, and service-level agreements (SLAs). - Improve automation and operating efficiency. Identify repetitive work and partner with global teams to introduce dependable automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual handoffs and improve execution. QUALIFICATIONS - 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing operations, marketing technology, revenue operations, or a closely related function. - Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, including Marketo and Salesforce, Adobe Experience Platform and familiarity with event or webinar technology. - Demonstrated experience improving database quality, segmentation, lead lifecycle processes, scoring, routing, and marketing-to-sales handoffs. - Strong analytical skills, with experience in campaign reporting, funnel analysis, attribution, and translating findings into operational improvements. - Experience supporting multiple markets and balancing global standards with regional business requirements. - Proven ability to work closely with Marketing, GTM, Sales Operations, and technical teams, influencing priorities and driving work through to completion. - Sound judgment around consent, customer data, privacy, and operational quality. NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting JAPAC markets, including local campaign execution and collaboration across languages and time zones. - Experience with ABM, buying-group engagement, and enterprise, developer, or startup audiences. - Familiarity with data integrations, APIs, and customer engagement or product-usage signals. - Practical experience building or improving AI-enabled workflows and automation. OpenAI is an equal opportunity employer, and we value thoughtful builders who bring curiosity, rigor, and care to complex work. If you are excited to help build effective, measurable marketing operations across JAPAC, we would love to hear from you. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe our research will eventually lead to artificial general intelligence, a system that can solve human-level problems. The Community & Culture Engagement team helps people discover, use, and advocate for OpenAI’s tools through community programs, social storytelling, creator partnerships, and cultural experiences. Our work connects OpenAI with the people and communities who bring its technology into everyday life. As the team grows across disciplines and markets, we need shared foundations that connect our work, make priorities clear, and help us deliver with speed and care. About the Role We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own Community & Culture’s integrated operating model. You will build and own the infrastructure that enables the team to operate as one and execute at a consistently high standard. You are accountable for keeping the plans funded, staffed and executable as priorities change. You will establish the shared practices, clear accountability, and reliable information that allow leaders to make sound decisions and teams to deliver on their commitments. This is a senior leadership role that combines organizational judgment with hands-on building. Working closely with Community & Culture leadership and partners across OpenAI, you will turn strategy into practical operating plans, anticipate risks, and guide decisions about where we invest and how we staff the work. You will build systems people trust and use, adapting them as priorities and the organization evolve. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Establish and own Community and Culture’s integrated operating model. This includes overseeing and building practical tools and workflows for financial management, resourcing, and operating reviews. - Own the team’s financial operating system. In partnership with Finance, Marketing, Partnerships and Comms leads, establish a consistent approach to budgeting, forecasting, spend approvals, and reporting across central and international teams. Maintain a trusted view of planned, committed, and actual spend. Responsible for driving tradeoff decisions, investment shifts and reallocation where needed. - Establish clear governance across the team. Define decision rights, build and own approval processes, clarify program ownership and appropriate handoffs to partner teams, and create clear escalation paths across the team. - Lead resourcing and capacity planning. Translate priorities into plans for full time, freelance, and agency remits. Identify gaps in skills and capacity, develop hiring and investment recommendations, and guide leaders through tradeoffs about where to add, shift, or sequence resources. - Build and own reliable agency and vendor operations. Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to establish clear processes for scopes of work, contracts, onboarding, purchase orders, and renewals. Ensure external commitments have clear owners, funding, and expectations. Guide and hold teams accountable to measurable outcomes from pilot programs. - Raise the standard of operational execution. Establish meaningful measures of forecast quality, planning reliability, capacity, and follow-through. Anticipate issues before they affect delivery and lead improvements as the team grows. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 10+ years of experience in operations, business operations, or a related discipline, including senior leadership responsibility for a complex, growing organization. - A successful track record of owning budgets, forecasts, and financial planning processes, with the judgment to help senior leaders weigh competing investments and resource needs. - Experience building governance and ways of working that have been adopted across multiple teams, with clear improvements in accountability and execution. - Experience leading workforce and capacity planning across employees, contractors, and agencies, and translating business priorities into practical staffing decisions. - Sound judgment in ambiguity. You make progress with incomplete information, adapt as priorities change, and know when a problem calls for a conversation, a decision, or a better process. - The ability to move between organizational strategy and detailed execution. You are comfortable shaping an operating model, working through a budget or staffing plan, and staying accountable through implementation. - An understanding of creative, community, marketing, or other relationship-driven teams. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The CXR Pathway Program is a paid program that launches your career in financial services. You'll be paid while you study for your SIE, Series 7 and Series 63 licenses and learn the job through hands-on, on-the-job training. You'll build foundational knowledge and confidence alongside your cohort, and finish the program ready to become a registered broker (Registered Representative). Learn by doing, from day one. While you study, you'll be on the job supporting customers across chat, email and phone, with needs ranging from simple to complex. We demonstrate insane customer focus, and you'll learn what that looks like in practice. As a member of this team, you'll be the company's voice and will use exceptional empathy and product expertise to ensure our users feel understood and valued. Your job is not only to help our customers, but to help us learn as a company from each interaction, so that we can make our customers' experience using our products as seamless as possible. This application is for our early talent with an anticipated start date in January 2027. We are looking for recent graduates who have customer-facing experience and are interested in becoming a Registered Representative through Robinhood's licensing and training program. Location: This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-month onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. channels Ability to quickly defuse customer anxiety through exceptional customer service skills Schedule flexibility as we evolve to meet the growing demands of our customers (future shift assignment items.title: Global Procurement Analyst
items.description: We are an AI company operating at the cutting edge of the industry, growing quickly in a fast-moving environment. As we scale and prepare for a future IPO, we are building our Procurement function from the ground up. This is our first Procurement Analyst role in the company, so you will help define how we buy, not just execute it. Your passion for Procurement will help build and run our source-to-pay processes with strong internal controls, clear segregation of duties between procurement and payment, and audit-ready documentation. This is a global role: you will support stakeholders and suppliers across regions and work closely with the rest of the Procure to Pay (P2P) and Finance teams. Key Responsibilities Procurement operations Manage the end-to-end purchasing operations across all spend categories (software, cloud, professional services, hardware, facilities, and more), from requisition intake and PO issuance in Zip / Coupa. Review purchase requests for completeness, budget and policy compliance before approval. Issue and track purchase orders, and follow up with suppliers on delivery, pricing, and service levels. Support RFQ/RFP processes: gather requirements, solicit/compare bids, and document selection rationale. Support negotiations and renewals in partnership with Legal and business owners. Support requesters across time zones and regions, handling multi-currency and cross-border purchasing needs. Controls and audit readiness Help design and implement procurement policies, approval matrices (delegation of authority), and procedures aligned with IPO and audit requirements. Enforce segregation of duties between procurement (requisition, sourcing, PO creation, vendor selection) and payment (invoice processing, payment execution), in coordination with Accounts Payable and Finance. Maintain complete, organized documentation for every purchase (quotes, approvals, contracts, POs) so it is available for internal and external audits. Monitor and report on policy exceptions, such as off-contract spend, retroactive POs, and split purchases, and escalate as needed. Support internal and external audit requests and help remediate findings. Vendor management Maintain accurate vendor master data and a centralized vendor and contract repository. Run supplier onboarding, including due diligence, documentation, tax compliance validation, and conflict-of-interest checks for domestic and international suppliers. Track supplier performance and support periodic vendor reviews using AI and other tools. Analysis and reporting Use AI to analyze spend data across categories and regions to identify savings opportunities, consolidation potential, and compliance gaps. Build regular reports and KPIs, such as spend under management, PO compliance, cycle times, and savings. Support budget tracking with Finance and flag potential overruns. Process improvement Contribute to the implementation and optimization of procurement tools and workflows, particularly Coupa and Zip. Document processes and create guidance and training for internal requesters. Propose and drive improvements that balance speed with control in a high-growth environment. Requirements Experience and knowledge 3+ years of experience in Procurement, Purchasing, or a related P2P function. Hands-on experience with Coupa and Zip or other modern procurement and AP tools. Familiarity with corporate procurement policies, guidelines, and internal controls. Understanding of P2P cycle and basic concepts of segregation of duties and approval workflows. Professional fluency in English (written and spoken), as you will primarily support global teams and suppliers. Core competencies (non-negotiable) Interpersonal skills: builds trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels and can say “no” or “not like this” constructively. Strong negotiation and influencing skills. Communication skills: communicate clearly, in English writing and verbally, with business teams, suppliers, and senior leaders, and can explain the “why” behind controls. Ownership and a bias for action in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to compliance and integrity. Self-management and strong written communication in a remote, cross-time-zone setting. Nice to have Experience in a high-growth, technology, or SaaS/AI company. Exposure to SOX, IPO readiness, or audit-ready environments. Familiarity with international supplier onboarding and tax documentation (e.g., W-8/W-9, VAT), and knowledge of EU, Mexican (CFDI, SAT compliance) as well as other government’s requirements. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. What Success Looks Like (first 6 to 12 months) Procurement policy and approval matrix adopted and followed by the business. Clear, enforced separation between procurement and payment activities. A centralized, audit-ready record for all purchases and vendors. Improved PO compliance and visibility into company spend. Positive feedback from business stakeholders on the speed and clarity of the purchasing process. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. You’ll be the senior data science leader embedded in our Core Apps product team and a strategic thought partner to its product leads. You’ll help set product direction for Claude Code and other new bets across Core Apps: bringing a point of view on where to invest, how to grow our Apps business, and how to deliver more value for our users. As a tech lead manager, you’ll also manage a small team of Product Data Scientists, setting their agenda and raising the bar for how data shapes product decisions. Core Apps, deciding where the Product Data Science team can have the most impact and what it should deprioritize Manage and develop a small team of Product Data Scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions Frame the most important and ambiguous questions facing the business, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction Define how Core Apps measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks that align teams and leadership on what matters Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Core Apps, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses Turn complex analyses into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Core Apps needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our products grow You may be a good fit if you have: Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product area at significant scale Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction and developing senior data scientists Have been a trusted partner to senior product and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others’ technical work Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress Care about the company’s mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI Strong candidates may also have: Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem The annual compensation range for this role is listed Field Service Engineering partners across design, construction, commissioning, site operations, hardware operations, and equipment providers to turn complex infrastructure into safe, reliable, and serviceable systems. About the Role We are seeking a senior, field service engineer to build the technical operating model responsible for critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure across our data center portfolio. This is a field-oriented electrical & mechanical engineering role, not a traditional facilities operations position. You will combine deep systems understanding in data center power and cooling systems to aid in SOO, design, maintenance & operability, troubleshooting and other engineering related responsibility around key equipment. The role will include leveraging training and experience to establish standards, develop people, coordinate vendors, and drive issues from design, first principles, first signals through verified resolution. The strongest candidates will have deep expertise in either electrical and mechanical systems and strong working fluency across the other discipline (e.g. controls, business acumen). Remote - travel 50% Key Responsibilities - Lead field support for startup, commissioning, troubleshooting, repair, and reliability improvement across critical data center infrastructure. - Serve as the senior technical owner for transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, PDUs, protection and controls, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, CDUs, CRAH units, and associated control systems. - Diagnose complex failures across power, cooling, controls, and hardware interfaces; distinguish symptoms from root causes and drive corrective actions through validation. - Build the field service operating model, including staffing recommendations, coverage, escalation paths, response expectations, spare-parts strategy, documentation, and performance metrics. - Aid in hiring, development, and coaching other field service engineers and technicians while creating a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, and continuous learning. - Partner with design, construction, commissioning, site operations, and hardware teams to improve maintainability, readiness, and lifecycle reliability. - Manage OEM and service-provider relationships, technical escalations, repair plans, warranties, and sustained corrective action. - Establish and improve safe work practices, including lockout/tagout, switching and maintenance procedures, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, and incident response. - Translate field learning into design feedback, preventive maintenance improvements, training, and reusable standards. items.title: Head of Stunt Marketing
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and sports is one of our biggest categories. The marketing team is small and moves fast. We don't have a big agency on retainer or a traditional campaign calendar. What we have is a platform that sits at the intersection of sports, news, and money, and a mandate to make the world aware of it in ways that actually stick. This role exists because guerilla and stunt marketing is one of the highest-leverage things we can do, and we need a dedicated person who owns it end to end. You'll be the one watching the game, spotting the moment, and showing up with something that earns press and goes viral, not because it was planned six months out, but because you moved faster than everyone else. The person who held this role before built a real playbook here. Your job is to run it, expand it, and make it yours. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll work closely with the marketing lead and have real autonomy, but you'll also be expected to operate independently in the field, often on short notice. If you need a lot of structure or sign-off to act, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive on finding the moment and executing before it passes, keep reading. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Identify stunt and activation concepts tied to live sports moments, news cycles, and cultural events, then pitch them fast with a clear point of view on why they'll land - Execute on-the-ground activations at stadiums, arenas, sports bars, and public venues, handling logistics, talent, materials, and timing yourself - Monitor social media and sports news in real time to spot openings for reactive content or physical activations before the moment passes - Coordinate all logistics for guerilla campaigns from concept through execution, including permits, vendors, travel, and on-site management - Build and maintain a pipeline of stunt ideas across the major sports calendar so the team is never starting from zero - Track campaign performance after each activation, pulling together data on reach, press pickups, social engagement, and earned media to inform what comes next - Represent Polymarket in the field in a way that reflects the brand, sharp, credible, and worth paying attention to WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5 or more years of experience in guerilla marketing, experiential marketing, or stunt-based brand work, with specific examples of campaigns you personally executed - A real track record of viral moments, not just campaigns that got approved, but things that actually spread and earned press coverage - High sports IQ across major American leagues, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and college sports, with enough fluency to know which moments matter and why - Demonstrated ability to execute independently in the field, you've shown up somewhere with a plan and made it happen without a team of ten behind you - Comfort operating on short timelines, some of the best opportunities here will have a 24 to 48 hour window - (Plus) Existing relationships with sports journalists, beat reporters, or media personalities who cover games and culture - (Plus) Experience at a sports betting, DFS, or prediction market brand - (Plus) Familiarity with crypto or web3 environments and audiences BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: IP Rights Manager
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an IP Rights Manager on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the operational backbone of how Mistral manages rights, obligations, and restrictions across the datasets we license. This role sits at the intersection of copyright, data protection, and AI, and exists because the volume and complexity of our data agreements have outgrown manual processes. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our agreements commercially and legally, translating their work into systems, workflows, and databases that keep us compliant and scalable. The IP & Licensing team is responsible for all content and data licensing at Mistral. Your work will directly determine whether we can use the data we acquire, how we track what we are allowed to do with it, and whether our clients and partners stay within the rights we grant them. You will build the infrastructure that makes legal analysis repeatable, not just advisory. Your scope spans the full lifecycle of data-related agreements: clearing inbound data usage requests, codifying contract terms into structured metadata, tracking ongoing compliance obligations, and automating reporting. You will also design and run AI-powered workflows that handle contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts, turning legal judgment into scalable operations. What You Will Do - Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions before data enters Mistral systems. - Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining the team's template library and playbook alongside Legal. - Determine whether specific AI use cases are covered by third-party agreements, identify gaps, and recommend contract amendments. - Build and maintain a central database as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement, covering permitted uses, confidentiality, and re-use permissions. - Track ongoing compliance obligations and automate reporting, including renewal alerts and master licensing partnership administration. - Develop and run AI workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and compliance monitoring. - Verify provenance, ownership, and consents for acquired data, flagging obligations that must be tracked. - Monitor that Mistral clients and partners operate within granted rights, administering the approval system that enforces legal restrictions. What We're Looking For - A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field. - 2 to 5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration, ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment. - Solid working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently. - Strong attention to detail and discretion when handling confidential agreements. - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain legal constraints to non-lawyers. - A legal-ops mindset: you take initiative, anticipate needs through ambiguity, and think about how to operationalize legal analysis at scale. - Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment; you are an AI power user, not just a consumer. - Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or another European language is a plus, as is experience with CLM tools like Ironclad, prior work setting up AI workflows in a legal team, or contracting experience with publishing houses. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. items.title: Field CTO, US
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going. You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move. WHAT YOU WILL DO Executive engagement Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory. Thought leadership Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations. Conference and event presence Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community. Market feedback Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. items.title: Sanctions Crypto Investigator
items.location_text: Denver, CO; New York, NY; Westlake, TX
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Financial Crimes (FinCrimes) Sanctions team plays a critical role in protecting Robinhood and its customers by identifying, investigating, and mitigating sanctions-related risks across our products and global operations. The team supports a rapidly evolving business, including cryptocurrency, brokerage, and money movement activities, while maintaining compliance with applicable U.S. and international sanctions requirements. As a Sanctions Crypto Investigator you will be responsible for investigating potential sanctions exposure associated with cryptocurrency transactions, digital asset wallets, and customer activity. You will leverage blockchain analytics, investigative tools, and sound risk-based judgment to identify potential sanctions violations, assess complex transaction activity, and document defensible investigative conclusions. This role is based in our Denver, CO, Westlake, TX, or New York NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct thorough investigations of cryptocurrency-related sanctions alerts, including customer screening matches, deposits, withdrawals, wallet addresses, and blockchain transactions. Leverage blockchain analytics tools, including TRM Labs or similar platforms, to evaluate direct and indirect sanctions exposure, trace transaction activity, and identify potential sanctions evasion typologies. Review and disposition potential matches against OFAC and other applicable sanctions lists, ensuring timely, accurate, and well-documented investigative decisions. Identify and escalate potential sanctions violations, including transactions or assets that may require blocking, rejecting, or additional regulatory review. Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive investigative narratives, supporting documentation, and escalation recommendations. Monitor emerging cryptocurrency sanctions risks, regulatory developments, and illicit finance typologies to support ongoing risk identification and mitigation. Partner with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Product, and other FinCrimes teams to resolve complex investigations and enhance sanctions screening capabilities. Identify opportunities to improve investigative workflows, screening effectiveness, operational efficiency, and automation. Assist with regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, quality assurance reviews, and management reporting. Maintain adherence to established procedures, regulatory requirements, and internal service-level expectations while managing investigative workloads. What you bring 3+ years of experience in financial crimes, sanctions investigations, AML compliance, or a related field within financial services, fintech, cryptocurrency, or another regulated environment. Demonstrated experience investigating cryptocurrency transactions and assessing financial crimes or sanctions-related risks. Working knowledge of blockchain technology, digital asset transactions, wallet addresses, and cryptocurrency transaction flows. Experience using blockchain analytics tools such as TRM Labs, Chainalysis, Elliptic, or comparable platforms. Strong understanding of OFAC sanctions regulations, sanctions screening requirements, and common sanctions evasion methodologies. Experience conducting complex investigations, evaluating potential true positive matches, and preparing clear, defensible investigative documentation. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex information and make sound, risk-based decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate investigative findings and recommendations effectively. Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain a high degree of accuracy in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative mindset and willingness to partner across teams to solve problems and improve existing processes. High standards of integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $94,000 — $110,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $82,000 — $97,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $73,000 — $86,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: ElevenMusic - Content Creator & Strategist
items.location_text: United States, Dublin, Europe, Japan, Mexico, Italy, Poland, United Kingdom, Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenMusic is our AI music creation platform, letting anyone turn an idea into a finished, studio-grade track in minutes, with control over genre, mood, structure, and vocals across multiple languages. It is one of the most exciting parts of the ElevenCreative suite, and we want its voice, community, and content presence to match the ambition of the product. We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own how ElevenMusic shows up in the world. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic, recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform, and publish them across our socials - Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible - Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap - Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics - Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work - Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops - Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and Marketing - Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand REQUIREMENTS - Demonstrated experience creating music and music-related content, with a portfolio of work you can share, you are a genuine music maker, not just a marketer - Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube - Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics - Comfortable presenting publicly, speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product - A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape, you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed BONUS - Experience building or growing a creator community (Discord, forums, or similar) - Background as a working musician, producer, or music educator with an existing audience - Experience giving product feedback or working closely with engineering/product teams - Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar) - Multilingual capabilities GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Lead content and community strategy across ElevenMusic as the product and team scale - Move into a broader creative or content role spanning video, editorial, and social across ElevenLabs brands - Expand into creator partnerships, evangelism, or brand marketing as the growth team evolves LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Why this role? We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech. Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill. Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included! As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will: - Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality. - Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy. - Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail. - Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines. - Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks. - Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters. - Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data. You may be a good fit if you have: - Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German; excellent command over English. - Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test. - Basic familiarity with JSON/TSV/CSV/Markdown data manipulation. - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails! - High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work. - Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently. - Superb sense of urgency and time management. - Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways. - A reliable laptop. The Candidate Journey: Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples. Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more. Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team! Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor. It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week. Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material. If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. items.title: Office Manager
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Office Manager to lead day-to-day operations at our office. You’ll be essential in creating a smooth, welcoming, and productive environment—ensuring everything from facilities to vendor coordination runs efficiently. You will: Develop and implement office policies and procedures to ensure smooth operations. Order and manage office supply inventory Manage F&B for our South Bay office Maintain Badging procurement for employees and new hires Plan and execute monthly employee engagement events Facilitate effective communication channels within the office, ensuring timely and accurate dissemination of information. Oversee maintenance and repair activities, ensuring the office is clean, safe, and well-maintained. Liaise with vendors, contractors, and suppliers for office-related services, equipment and F&B. Manage office equipment and technology, including computers and printers. Address any facility issues promptly and efficiently. Assist with collecting, cleaning, and resetting laptops Monitor and manage office budgets and expenses Serve as a point of contact between employees, management, and external stakeholders Coordinate with the finance department for expense tracking and reporting. About you: Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to prioritize tasks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in office software tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, database management). Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Location: This role is onsite (5 days a week in our Mountain View office) Compensation & Benefits: This role will be a 6 -month contract position with the possibility of extension and/or conversion based on performance and company needs. The range for this position is $35-$45/ hour. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-ONSITE AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: Customer Experience Associate, Money
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Money Customer Experience team is responsible for providing our customers with the best experience possible while using our product. We act as the "voice of the customer," collaborating closely within the team, leadership, and other support functions to ensure our customers have the best experience with our products and the services we offer. We serve as dedicated customer advocates, actively highlighting key product features and benefits to continually enhance and advance our services. We also build and maintain the tools necessary to provide exemplary service in each interaction. Our high-performing team is dedicated to supporting customers and ensuring their satisfaction! As a Customer Experience Associate with Money , you will serve as a subject matter expert on our Credit Card and Banking products and customer support processes. You will be the front-line expert responsible for assisting our cardholders with their most challenging inquiries. In this role, you will independently navigate complex inquiries, leveraging your subject matter expertise, departmental guidelines, and a compassionate, empathetic approach to resolve cardholder concerns with care and efficiency. Your work will directly impact customer trust and help drive the long-term success of our financial products! This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-week onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Bring deep customer empathy and a passion for providing exceptional customer service to every cardholder. Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to remain adaptable as support processes evolve. Investigate details independently, escalate issues appropriately, and identify emerging trends that may indicate product bugs. Learn and grow continuously as our banking and credit card services expand. Act as an advocate for our products and services, driving continuous improvement based on customer feedback. What you bring Possess 1+ years of customer service, financial services or contact center support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education. Demonstrate a basic understanding of financial products, or a strong willingness to learn about them. Show familiarity with text, email, and phone-based customer support channels. Apply basic working knowledge of Salesforce or similar customer relationship management (CRM) platforms. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more! Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 2 compensation zones. This role is also eligible to participate in a Robinhood bonus plan. Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $21.30 — $25 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $20.40 — $24 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
